caption: The drawing depicts a Victorian-style parlor filled with various objects and furniture arranged throughout the room. In the foreground, there is a large, ornate black cast iron stove with a visible fire inside, resting on a mat with a kettle to one side and a pair of shoes in front. To the right, a dark, fringed chaise lounge with golden trim sits next to a small side table holding a teapot and cup, and a blue book lies on the floor nearby. A central coffee table displays items such as a feather quill in an inkwell, a small bottle, eyeglasses, and a piece of sheet music or a sign reading “Minister’s Study Hours.” Two carved wooden chairs with embroidered cushions face each other near a green area rug. Behind the chairs, an ornately decorated organ occupies the left back wall with a round stool in front, flanked by candlesticks and books, and a large mirror above it. In the center back, a large pink upholstered chair with elaborate trim sits in front of sheer curtains and a window. To the right, a wooden bookshelf filled with books and topped with vases and a bust stands next to a matching wooden dresser-mirror-combination on which a candelabra rests, and in front sits a pink-cushioned stool. A treadle sewing machine with blue fabric draped over it stands against the right wall. The floor is covered with multiple rugs in green and gray hues. Overhead, a gold chandelier with pink-tinted glass shades hangs in the middle of the room. The wallpaper is striped in pastel colors with blue garlands near the ceiling. On the left, a painting of a nighttime scene is hung above the stove, and to the right, an arched doorway leads into another room decorated with floral wallpaper, a wall clock, and what appears to be more furniture. A gas lamp and shelf are also discernible on the left wall, adding to the detailed interior scene.
title: Rural Sitting Room, 1900
